idea-plugin.name: Postgres Migration Lock Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Names every statement in a Rails, Django or raw SQL migration that takes a table-blocking Postgres lock, and prints the non-blocking rewrite. 36 rules, PostgreSQL 12-17.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Postgres Migration Lock Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 36 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/pg-migration-lock-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/pg-migration-lock-lint

action.text: Postgres Migration Lock Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run Postgres Migration Lock Lint on the file in the editor
